packageRules.description: CI runs OpenTofu, which installs providers from the OpenTofu registry. It mirrors new releases hours after registry.terraform.io, so look versions up there to avoid proposing ones tofu cannot download yet.

TeamSpeak 6 server only ships pre-release tags (6.0.0-betaN). With semver/docker versioning the -betaN suffix is compared lexically, so 6.0.0-beta10 sorts BELOW 6.0.0-beta9 and license-refresh bumps are missed. Use regex versioning with a numeric <build> group so the beta number orders numerically, and automerge so refreshes land before the license expires. Revisit when TeamSpeak 6 leaves beta.
The PostgreSQL image refuses to start on a data directory from another major, so a major needs a planned dump and restore (or pg_upgrade). Hold majors for approval on the dependency dashboard.
InfluxDB 3 is a different product with no in-place upgrade from 2.x.
InfluxDB 2.x minors migrate the metadata store one way, so review them instead of automerging.
